name: Ford Falcon six
description: The Ford 188 and 221 pushrod inline six of the Argentine Falcon, the Sprint's 221 SP and Oreste Berta's racing 221, with the factory engines of the cars that came with a six of its kind. Every model by Pablo Camardelli, made in 3ds Max.
credits: Modelled by Pablo Camardelli (pecamardelli) in 3ds Max
